title: EU1 GPUs across sites
description: Every GPU of both EU1 sites through Thanos Query. Use case 6. site=fin-sim is simulated.

panels.title: GPU utilisation, every GPU of every site
panels.description: Whole GPUs: DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL, one line per GPU. MIG instances don't report GPU_UTIL, so each instance gets a line from DCGM_FI_PROF_GR_ENGINE_ACTIVE, the share of time its graphics engine was active, as a percentage. The two are close but not the same measure. Aggregated by GPU or instance, not by exporter pod, so a restart of the exporter doesn't draw a second line. Queries tested in gitops/manifests/platform/gpu-rules/tests/.

targets.expr: 100 * max by (site, modelName, hostname, gpu, GPU_I_ID, GPU_I_PROFILE) (DCGM_FI_PROF_GR_ENGINE_ACTIVE{site=~"$site", GPU_I_ID!=""})

panels.title: Framebuffer used
panels.description: Per physical GPU. A GPU split by MIG reports framebuffer per instance, so its instances are added up.

targets.expr: sum by (site, modelName, hostname, gpu) (max by (site, modelName, hostname, gpu, GPU_I_ID) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{site=~"$site"}))

panels.title: DCGM series per GPU
panels.description: From the recording rule gpu:dcgm_series:count, evaluated on each site. MIG instances count against their GPU; the table below splits them. A series count, not a GPU count.

panels.title: Which DCGM metrics carry the most series
Sites seen in this time range
panels.description: Last time each site sent anything. A site that has been deleted stays in this table with its last timestamp: its data is served from Receive, then from Garage.

panels.title: DCGM series per GPU and MIG instance
panels.description: From the recording rule gpu:dcgm_series_by_instance:count. A whole GPU has one row; a GPU split by MIG has a row for the device and one per instance. Empty for any period before the rule was deployed on that site.

targets.expr: max by (site, modelName, hostname, gpu, GPU_I_ID, GPU_I_PROFILE) (max_over_time(gpu:dcgm_series_by_instance:count{site=~"$site"}[$__range]))

panels.title: GPUs per site in this time range
panels.description: Physical GPUs that reported framebuffer at any time in the range, whole or split by MIG. Counted by GPU, not by series: a GPU's series change with its exporter pod and the tenant pods on it.

targets.expr: count by (site, modelName) (max by (site, modelName, hostname, gpu) (last_over_time(DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{site=~"$site"}[$__range])))
